How It Works

From first photo to pickup in six easy steps. Most pieces are ready in 5–7 business days once your slot starts.

1

Send photos

DM or email photos of the front, side, and top — plus any damage — along with measurements.

2

Get your quote

A firm price and the next available slot, within 1 business day.

3

Pick your finish

Any color, stain, and hardware — catalogs are examples, not limits. It's your style.

4

Book your slot

25% deposit books your week. Balance is due at pickup. Deposit is non-refundable once paint is bought.

5

Drop it off in Dade City

Drop off at the workshop, or ask about pickup for custom pieces at $1/mile each way. Ready in 5–7 business days.

6

Pick up your “new” piece

You get before & after photos and a 30-day touch-up promise on the finish.

✦One custom slot per week, so every piece gets full attention. December is now booking — send your photos to hold your week.

What's included in every refinish

  • Full prep + primer + 2 coats of Behr paint in a satin finish
  • Hardware cleaned and reinstalled (or swapped for your new picks)
  • Drawers checked so everything opens and closes smoothly
  • A progress photo while your piece is in the shop
  • Before & after photos when it's done
  • 30-day touch-up promise on your finish

Buying a finished piece instead? Delivery is FREE within 15 miles, no minimum — and $1.50 per extra mile beyond that.

About the Owner

Hi, I'm Frannel Franco — owner and refinisher behind Refinished by Franco. I refinish solid wood furniture by hand in Dade City, Florida, serving Wesley Chapel, Zephyrhills, and the wider Pasco area.

I focus on solid wood because it deserves a second life — it's built to last, it takes paint and stain beautifully, and it beats flat-pack furniture every time. Whether it's a dresser you already own and love, or a sturdy piece that just needs your color, my job is the same: careful prep, a smooth durable finish, and a piece you're proud to have back in your home.

“Old wood. New life. Your style.” — that's not just a slogan. It's what happens in the shop every week.
